title: Croquet Monsieur Vivaldi

2 slices of a nice thick cut bread

3. Remove from heat and stir in salt, pepper, nutmeg, and a portion of the grated Gruyère cheese.
4. Spread Dijon mustard on one side of the bread slices.
5. Assemble the sandwich with the béchamel sauce and ham.
6. Toast the sandwich in a frying pan with butter until golden brown on both sides.
